attackers_goals: The attacker might deceive the victim into resetting their password, a common tactic in account takeover schemes.
description: A user used a weak factor to reset their Okta password.
detection_modules: Identity Threat Module, SaaS Threat Detection
investigative_actions: Monitor the user account for indications of compromise, such as irregular login patterns or atypical activities. Reach out to the user to confirm the legitimacy of the recent password reset activity. Examine the IP address and assess its reputation. Continue monitoring the account for any subsequent actions that may indicate suspicious behavior.
